title: chrysanthemum maritimum var. agreste
intro: Chrysanthemum maritimum var. agreste, commonly known as Agrestis, is a variety of the Chrysanthemum maritimum plant, a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Chrysanthemum maritimum var. agreste include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
